# 1. Read and normalise metadata / 读取并规范化元数据

```{r read-metadata}
md_16s <- read_meta("16S")
md_its <- read_meta("ITS")
md <- rbindlist(list(md_16s, md_its), fill = TRUE)

md[, Region  := factor(Region, levels = REG_LEVELS)]
md[, dataset := factor(dataset, levels = c("16S", "ITS"))]
md[, kingdom := factor(kingdom, levels = c("Bacteria", "Fungi"))]
md[, src_group := factor(
  data.table::fcase(Cite == "S58", SRC_LEVELS[2],
                    Cite == "S59", SRC_LEVELS[3],
                    default      = SRC_LEVELS[1]),
  levels = SRC_LEVELS)]

stopifnot(nrow(md_16s) == 4012L, nrow(md_its) == 2337L)
cat(sprintf("16S: %d samples | ITS: %d samples | combined: %d\n",
            nrow(md_16s), nrow(md_its), nrow(md)))

cat("\nPlatform normalisation:\n")
print(md[, .N, by = .(Platform, PlatformN)][order(-N)])

cat("\nCountry normalisation (changed values):\n")
print(unique(md[Country != CountryRaw, .(CountryRaw, Country)]))
```

```{r shared-metadata}
# Cleaned metadata shared by all chapters
write_int(md_16s, CHAPTER, "metadata_16S_clean", shared = TRUE)
write_int(md_its, CHAPTER, "metadata_ITS_clean", shared = TRUE)

# Platform mapping provenance
plat_map <- md[, .(n_samples = .N), by = .(Platform, PlatformN)][order(PlatformN, -n_samples)]
write_int(plat_map, CHAPTER, "platform_normalization", shared = TRUE)

# Country mapping provenance
ctry_map <- md[, .(n_samples = .N),
               by = .(original_country = CountryRaw, mapped_country = Country)][
                 order(-n_samples)]
write_int(ctry_map, CHAPTER, "country_normalization", shared = TRUE)

save_rds(md, CHAPTER, "metadata_combined")
```

# 2. Dataset overview table / 数据集总览表

```{r tab-overview}
stats_row <- function(d, ds_label, region_label) {
  g <- d[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .N, by = Genus]
  q <- if (nrow(g)) g[N >= 3, .N] else 0L
  data.table(
    dataset                = ds_label,
    region                 = region_label,
    samples                = nrow(d),
    sources                = uniqueN(d$source),
    papers                 = uniqueN(d$Cite),
    countries              = n_distinct_nonmissing(d$Country),
    host_genera            = uniqueN(d$Genus[!is.na(d$Genus) & d$Genus != ""]),
    host_species           = uniqueN(d$species[!is.na(d$species) & d$species != ""]),
    qualified_host_genera  = q,
    seed                   = sum(d$extract == "Seed", na.rm = TRUE),
    germinating            = sum(d$extract == "Germinating", na.rm = TRUE),
    SD                     = sum(d$IF_SD == "SD", na.rm = TRUE),
    NSD                    = sum(d$IF_SD == "NSD", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tab1 <- rbindlist(list(
  stats_row(md[dataset == "16S"], "16S", "All"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "16S" & Region == "V3_V4"], "16S", "V3_V4"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "16S" & Region == "V4"],    "16S", "V4"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "16S" & Region == "V5_V6"], "16S", "V5_V6"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "16S" & Region == "V5_V7"], "16S", "V5_V7"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "ITS"], "ITS", "All"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "ITS" & Region == "ITS1"], "ITS", "ITS1"),
  stats_row(md[dataset == "ITS" & Region == "ITS2"], "ITS", "ITS2"),
  stats_row(md, "Combined", "All")
))
write_tab(tab1, CHAPTER, "Tab_1_dataset_overview")
tab1
```

# 3. Design: extract × sterilization / 组织 × 消毒设计

```{r tab-design}
make_design <- function(d, ds_label) {
  grid <- CJ(extract = c("Seed", "Germinating"),
             IF_SD   = c("SD", "NSD"))
  s <- d[, .(samples = .N, sources = uniqueN(source), papers = uniqueN(Cite)),
         by = .(extract, IF_SD)]
  out <- s[grid, on = .(extract, IF_SD)]
  out[is.na(samples), `:=`(samples = 0L, sources = 0L, papers = 0L)]
  out[, dataset := ds_label]
  setcolorder(out, c("dataset", "extract", "IF_SD", "samples", "sources", "papers"))
  out[]
}

tab_design <- rbindlist(list(
  make_design(md[dataset == "16S"], "16S"),
  make_design(md[dataset == "ITS"], "ITS"),
  make_design(md, "Combined")
))
tab_design[, dataset := factor(dataset, levels = c("16S", "ITS", "Combined"))]
setorder(tab_design, dataset, extract, IF_SD)
write_tab(tab_design, CHAPTER, "Tab_1_design_counts")
write_int(tab_design, CHAPTER, "extract_sterilization_counts")
tab_design
```

```{r tab-country-region}
cr <- dcast(md, Country ~ Region, value.var = "SampleID",
```

# 6. Source registry / 研究来源登记

```{r tab-source-registry}
src <- md[, .(
  Cite           = paste(sort(unique(Cite)), collapse = ";"),
  kingdoms       = paste(sort(unique(as.character(kingdom))), collapse = ";"),
  n_samples      = .N,
  n_16S          = sum(dataset == "16S"),
  n_ITS          = sum(dataset == "ITS"),
  n_countries    = n_distinct_nonmissing(Country),
  regions_16S    = paste(intersect(REG_LEVELS, unique(Region[dataset == "16S"])), collapse = ","),
  regions_ITS    = paste(intersect(REG_LEVELS, unique(Region[dataset == "ITS"])), collapse = ","),
  platforms      = paste(sort(unique(PlatformN)), collapse = ";"),
  seed_n         = sum(extract == "Seed"),
  germinating_n  = sum(extract == "Germinating"),
  SD_n           = sum(IF_SD == "SD"),
  NSD_n          = sum(IF_SD == "NSD"),
  n_host_genera  = uniqueN(Genus[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != ""])
), by = source]

# host genera with >=3 samples within this source (both kingdoms combined)
qg <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .N, by = .(source, Genus)][
  N >= 3, .(n_qualified_host_genera = .N), by = source]
src[qg, n_qualified_host_genera := i.n_qualified_host_genera, on = "source"]
src[is.na(n_qualified_host_genera), n_qualified_host_genera := 0L]

# Part A candidate: >=2 host genera with >=3 samples, kingdoms pooled within source
qgs <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .N, by = .(source, Genus)][
  N >= 3, .(n_qualified = .N), by = source][n_qualified >= 2]
src[qgs, partA_candidate := TRUE, on = "source"]
src[is.na(partA_candidate), partA_candidate := FALSE]

# Analysis-feasible units: >=2 qualified host genera within one kingdom
qgd <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .N,
          by = .(source, dataset, Genus)][N >= 3, .(n_qual = .N),
          by = .(source, dataset)][n_qual >= 2]
pa16 <- qgd[dataset == "16S", .(partA_16S = TRUE), by = source]
pait <- qgd[dataset == "ITS", .(partA_ITS = TRUE), by = source]
src[pa16, partA_16S := i.partA_16S, on = "source"]
src[pait, partA_ITS := i.partA_ITS, on = "source"]
src[is.na(partA_16S), partA_16S := FALSE]
src[is.na(partA_ITS), partA_ITS := FALSE]

# Part B pool membership: host genus x region with >=5 sources
pool_src <- unique(md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "",
                      .(dataset, Region, Genus, source)])
pool_ok <- pool_src[, .(n_sources = uniqueN(source)),
                    by = .(dataset, Region, Genus)][n_sources >= 5]
pool_ok[, pool := paste(dataset, as.character(Region), Genus, sep = "|")]
ps <- pool_src[pool_ok[, .(dataset, Region, Genus, pool)],
               on = .(dataset, Region, Genus), nomatch = 0]
pools_by_source <- ps[, .(partB_pools = paste(sort(pool), collapse = ";")), by = source]
src[pools_by_source, partB_pools := i.partB_pools, on = "source"]
src[is.na(partB_pools), partB_pools := ""]

# Coarse pool cells (dataset x extract x sterilization)
cells <- md[, .(coarse_cells = paste(sort(unique(paste(dataset, extract, IF_SD, sep = "/"))),
                                     collapse = ";")), by = source]
src[cells, coarse_cells := i.coarse_cells, on = "source"]

setorder(src, -n_samples)
setcolorder(src, c("source", "Cite", "kingdoms", "n_samples", "n_16S", "n_ITS",
                   "n_countries", "regions_16S", "regions_ITS", "platforms",
                   "seed_n", "germinating_n", "SD_n", "NSD_n",
                   "n_host_genera", "n_qualified_host_genera",
                   "partA_candidate", "partA_16S", "partA_ITS",
                   "partB_pools", "coarse_cells"))
write_tab(src, CHAPTER, "Tab_1_source_registry")

cat("sources:", nrow(src), " partA candidate:", sum(src$partA_candidate),
    " analysis units 16S:", sum(src$partA_16S),
    " ITS:", sum(src$partA_ITS), "\n")
cat("Part B pools:", nrow(pool_ok), "\n")
print(pool_ok[, .(dataset, Region, Genus, n_sources)][order(dataset, Region, Genus)])
head(src, 8)
```

# 8. Reads mapped to reference sequences / 参考序列比对比例

```{r mapping-fraction}
# mapped = ASV ID in Merged_{16S_Silva,ITS_Unite}_filtered.fa
# unmapped = ASV ID in Merged_{16S,ITS}_Unmapped_filtered.fa
mapping_fraction <- function(ds) {
  dir <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", ds)
  ref_fa <- file.path(dir, if (ds == "16S") "Merged_16S_Silva_filtered.fa"
                           else "Merged_ITS_Unite_filtered.fa")
  unm_fa <- file.path(dir, sprintf("Merged_%s_Unmapped_filtered.fa", ds))
  fa_ids <- function(f) {
    h <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
    x <- sub("^>", "", h[startsWith(h, ">")])
    sub("\\s.*$", "", x)
  }
  ref_ids <- fa_ids(ref_fa)
  unm_ids <- fa_ids(unm_fa)
  cat(sprintf("  [%s] reference ASVs %d; unmapped ASVs %d; overlap %d\n",
              ds, length(ref_ids), length(unm_ids),
              length(intersect(ref_ids, unm_ids))))

  tab <- fread(file.path(dir, sprintf("Merged_%s_table_filtered.txt", ds)),
               sep = "\t", colClasses = list(character = 1))
  setnames(tab, 1, "ASV_ID")
  stopifnot(all(tab$ASV_ID %in% c(ref_ids, unm_ids)))

  m <- as.matrix(tab[, -1, with = FALSE])
  tot <- colSums(m)
  msum <- colSums(m[tab$ASV_ID %in% ref_ids, , drop = FALSE])
  rm(m); invisible(gc())

  meta_ids <- md[dataset == ds, SampleID]
  cat(sprintf("  [%s] table samples %d; not in metadata %d; metadata without table %d\n",
              ds, ncol(tab) - 1, length(setdiff(names(tot), meta_ids)),
              length(setdiff(meta_ids, names(tot)))))

  data.table(SampleID = names(tot), dataset = ds,
             total_reads = tot, mapped_reads = msum,
             mapped_pct = 100 * msum / tot)
}

mf_path <- file.path(int_dir(CHAPTER), "reference_mapping_fraction.tsv")
if (!isTRUE(params$rebuild_mapping_fraction) && file.exists(mf_path)) {
  cat("reuse existing intermediate:", mf_path, "\n")
  mf <- fread(mf_path, sep = "\t")
} else {
  mf <- rbindlist(list(mapping_fraction("16S"), mapping_fraction("ITS")))
  write_int(mf, CHAPTER, "reference_mapping_fraction")
}
cat(sprintf("median reference-mapped reads: 16S %.1f%%, ITS %.1f%%\n",
            median(mf[dataset == "16S"]$mapped_pct),
            median(mf[dataset == "ITS"]$mapped_pct)))
```

# 9. Figure: samples by study set, split by region / 样本量图

```{r fig-samples-by-source}
d <- read_int(CHAPTER, "source_group_region_counts")
d[, Region    := factor(Region, levels = REG_LEVELS)]
d[, src_group := factor(src_group, levels = SRC_LEVELS)]
d[, seglab := fifelse(samples >= 100, as.character(samples), "")]
tot <- d[, .(samples = sum(samples)), by = src_group]

p <- ggplot(d, aes(src_group, samples, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = seglab), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 2.2, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = tot, aes(src_group, samples, label = samples),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.45, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = REG_COL, name = "Region") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of samples") +
  theme_seed() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_1_samples_by_source", 100, 100)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_1_samples_by_source")
p
```

# 10. Figure: extract x sterilization design by region / 设计图

```{r fig-design}
d <- read_int(CHAPTER, "extract_sterilization_region_counts")
grid <- CJ(Region = REG_LEVELS, extract = c("Seed", "Germinating"),
           IF_SD = c("SD", "NSD"))
d <- d[grid, on = .(Region, extract, IF_SD)]
d[is.na(samples), `:=`(samples = 0L, species = 0L)]
d[, combo := factor(paste(extract, IF_SD, sep = " x "),
                    levels = c("Seed x SD", "Seed x NSD",
                               "Germinating x SD", "Germinating x NSD"))]
d[, Region := factor(Region, levels = REG_LEVELS)]

heat_design <- function(var, low, high) {
  vmax <- max(d[[var]])
  ggplot(d, aes(Region, combo, fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = .data[[var]],
                  colour = .data[[var]] > 0.55 * vmax),
              size = 2.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low, high = high, limits = c(0, vmax),
                        guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "white")) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(d$combo))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_seed() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1))
}

p1 <- heat_design("samples", "#F4F1EA", "#3A5A40")
p2 <- heat_design("species", "#FBF0E6", "#B4521F")
p  <- p1 + p2
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_1_extract_sterilization_design", 150, 75)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_1_extract_sterilization_design")
p
```

# 11. Figure: world map of samples / 世界地图

```{r fig-world-map}
suppressMessages(library(sf))

cc <- read_int(CHAPTER, "country_counts")
shp <- st_read(file.path(DATA_DIR, "gis", "ne_110m_admin_0_countries",
                         "ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp"), quiet = TRUE)
shp <- shp[shp$NAME != "Antarctica", c("NAME", "geometry")]

map <- left_join(shp, cc, by = c("NAME" = "Country"))
map$total[is.na(map$total)] <- 0
cat("metadata countries matched to Natural Earth:",
    sum(cc$Country %in% shp$NAME), "/", nrow(cc), "\n")
cat("unmatched:", paste(setdiff(cc$Country, shp$NAME), collapse = ", "), "\n")

top8 <- cc[order(-total)][1:8]
map_top <- map[map$NAME %in% top8$Country, ]
lab_pts <- st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(map_top))
lab_df <- data.frame(
  NAME  = map_top$NAME,
  total = map_top$total,
  X     = st_coordinates(lab_pts)[, 1],
  Y     = st_coordinates(lab_pts)[, 2]
)
offs <- data.frame(
  NAME = c("France", "Australia", "China", "United States of America",
           "South Korea", "Austria", "Spain", "Colombia"),
  dx   = c(-18, -18, 12, -18, 10, 10, -14, -14),
  dy   = c(8, -6, -12, 7, -18, 10, -12, -8),
  hj   = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(lab_df$NAME %in% offs$NAME))
lab_df <- merge(lab_df, offs, by = "NAME", sort = FALSE)
lab_df$lab_x <- lab_df$X + lab_df$dx
lab_df$lab_y <- lab_df$Y + lab_df$dy
lab_df$label <- paste0(lab_df$NAME, " (", lab_df$total, ")")

p <- ggplot(map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
  geom_segment(data = lab_df, aes(x = X, y = Y, xend = lab_x, yend = lab_y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.18, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_text(data = lab_df[lab_df$hj == 1, ],
            aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(data = lab_df[lab_df$hj == 0, ],
            aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#EEEEEE", "#C5D8E7", "#81B29A", "#3A5A40"),
    trans = "log1p",
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100", "1000"),
    name = "Samples",
    na.value = "grey92"
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin", default_crs = st_crs(4326), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_seed() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2),
        axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.01, 0.01),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.key.width  = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
        legend.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm"))
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_1_world_map", 160, 85)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_1_world_map")
```

# 13. Figure: reads mapped to reference sequences / 比对比例图

```{r fig-mapping-fraction}
mf <- read_int(CHAPTER, "reference_mapping_fraction")
mf[, kingdom := factor(fifelse(dataset == "16S", "Bacteria", "Fungi"),
                       levels = c("Bacteria", "Fungi"))]
med <- mf[, .(med = round(median(mapped_pct), 1)), by = kingdom]

p <- ggplot(mf, aes(mapped_pct, fill = kingdom)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0, 100, 2.5), colour = "white",
                 linewidth = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(data = med, aes(xintercept = med),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = med, aes(x = med - 2, y = Inf, label = paste0("median ", med, "%")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.3) +
  facet_wrap(~kingdom, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = KING_COL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), limits = c(0, 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = "Reads mapped to reference (%)", y = "Number of samples") +
  theme_seed() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_1_reference_mapping_fraction", 160, 80)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_1_reference_mapping_fraction")
p
```

# 14. Host genus tree with iTOL annotation / 宿主属树与 iTOL 注释

```{r host-genus-tree}
suppressMessages({
  library(ape)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(itol.toolkit)
})

tree_species <- read.tree(host_tree_path("plant_species_tree_all.nwk"))

# one randomly chosen species per host genus (fixed seed for reproducibility).
# Genera with fewer than 3 samples (16S + ITS combined) are pruned from the tree.
# Only species whose name belongs to the genus are eligible; "Rorripa" is a
# spelling variant of Rorippa. Leucospermum has species Scabiosa_lucida in the
# metadata (family conflict) and therefore has no valid representative.
spp <- unique(md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .(Genus, species)])
spp[, sp_genus := sub("_.*$", "", species)]
spp[sp_genus == "Rorripa", sp_genus := "Rorippa"]
spp <- spp[sp_genus == Genus]

genus_n      <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .(n_samples = .N), by = Genus]
few_samples  <- genus_n[n_samples < 3, Genus]

set.seed(20261119)
pick <- spp[, .SD[sample.int(.N, 1)], by = Genus]
pick <- pick[Genus %in% genus_n[n_samples >= 3, Genus]]

excluded <- data.table(
  Genus = setdiff(unique(md$Genus[!is.na(md$Genus) & md$Genus != ""]),
                  pick$Genus)
)
excluded[, reason := data.table::fcase(
  Genus %in% few_samples,
  "fewer than 3 samples",
  default = "no species name belonging to this genus (metadata conflict)"
)]

genus_tree <- keep.tip(tree_species, pick$species)
stopifnot(Ntip(genus_tree) == nrow(pick))

# map each tree tip (species) to its genus, in tree-tip order
sp2gen    <- setNames(pick$Genus, pick$species)
tip_genus <- unname(sp2gen[genus_tree$tip.label])
stopifnot(!anyNA(tip_genus), !anyDuplicated(tip_genus))

tip <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .(
  Order     = Order[1],
  Family    = Family[1],
  Class     = Class[1],
  n_sources = uniqueN(source),
  n_samples = .N
), by = Genus]
tip <- tip[match(tip_genus, Genus)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(tip$Genus))
tip[, representative_species := pick$species[match(Genus, pick$Genus)]]
genus_tree$tip.label <- paste0(tip$Genus, "_", tip$n_sources)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(genus_tree$tip.label))
stopifnot(all(sub("_[0-9]+$", "", genus_tree$tip.label) == tip$Genus))

# ---- tree file + iTOL annotation files ----
td  <- tree_dir(CHAPTER)
nwk <- file.path(td, "host_genus_tree.nwk")
write.tree(genus_tree, nwk)

# genus order is read back from the tree file; Orders follow the first
# appearance of each Order along that tip sequence
written    <- read.tree(nwk)
gen_order  <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", written$tip.label)
stopifnot(identical(gen_order, tip$Genus))
ord_lev    <- unique(tip$Order)
ORD_COL    <- setNames(pal_multi(length(ord_lev)), ord_lev)

# export the Order -> colour mapping in tree-tip (phylogenetic) order
ord_col_tab <- data.table(Order = ord_lev,
                          colour = unname(ORD_COL),
                          rank = seq_along(ord_lev))
fwrite(ord_col_tab, file.path(td, "host_order_colors.tsv"),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
write_tab(ord_col_tab, CHAPTER, "Tab_1_host_order_colors")

fwrite(tip[order(Genus), .(Genus, representative_species, Order,
                           Family, Class, n_sources, n_samples)],
       file.path(td, "host_genus_tree_tips.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

fwrite(excluded[order(reason, Genus)],
       file.path(td, "excluded_genera.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

df_order <- data.frame(id = genus_tree$tip.label,
                       Order = tip$Order,
                       colour = unname(ORD_COL[tip$Order]),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df_bar   <- data.frame(id = genus_tree$tip.label,
                       log2_samples = log2(tip$n_samples),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hub <- create_hub(tree = nwk)

unit_Host_order <- create_unit(data = df_order,
                          key = "Host_order",
                          type = "DATASET_COLORSTRIP",
                          tree = nwk)
unit_Host_order@common_themes$legend$horizontal = NULL  # vertical legend / 图例竖排
hub <- hub + unit_Host_order
unit_samples <- create_unit(data = df_bar,
                            key = "log2_samples",
                            type = "DATASET_SIMPLEBAR",
                            tree = nwk)
unit_samples@profile$color = "#1A6C92"
unit_samples@specific_themes$basic_plot$width = 250
unit_samples@specific_themes$basic_plot$dataset_scale = c(1,3,5,7,9)
hub <- hub + unit_samples
write_hub(hub, td)

# align annotations with the figure palette
order_file <- file.path(td, "Host_order.txt")
order_txt  <- readLines(order_file)
order_txt  <- sub("^COLOR_BRANCHES\t.*$", "COLOR_BRANCHES\t0", order_txt)
order_txt  <- sub("^LEGEND_HORIZONTAL\t.*$", "LEGEND_HORIZONTAL\t0", order_txt)
writeLines(order_txt, order_file)
bar_file <- file.path(td, "log2_samples.txt")
bar_txt  <- readLines(bar_file)
bar_txt  <- sub("^COLOR\t.*$", "COLOR\t#8C6D31", bar_txt)
bar_txt  <- bar_txt[!grepl("^LEGEND_(SHAPES|COLORS|LABELS)\t", bar_txt)]
bar_txt  <- sub("^LEGEND_TITLE\t.*$", "LEGEND_TITLE\tlog2(samples)", bar_txt)
writeLines(bar_txt, bar_file)

writeLines(c(
  "Host genus tree (Chapter 1)",
  "- host_genus_tree.nwk: species tree pruned to one randomly chosen species",
  "  per host genus (set.seed(20261119)); tip labels = Genus_n_sources.",
  "- Genera with fewer than 3 samples (16S + ITS combined) are pruned.",
  "- Host_order.txt: iTOL DATASET_COLORSTRIP, colour ring by host Order.",
  "- host_order_colors.tsv: Order -> colour mapping in phylogenetic order.",
  "- log2_samples.txt: iTOL DATASET_SIMPLEBAR, log2(number of samples).",
  "- host_genus_tree_tips.tsv: representative species, Order/Family and counts.",
  "- excluded_genera.tsv: genera excluded because they have fewer than 3",
  "  samples, or because no species name belongs to the genus.",
  "  Leucospermum is coded with species Scabiosa_lucida (Proteaceae vs",
  "  Caprifoliaceae conflict), so it cannot be placed reliably."
), file.path(td, "README.txt"))

cat(sprintf("genus tree: %d tips, %d orders; excluded %d genera (<3 samples: %d; no valid species: %d)\n",
            Ntip(genus_tree), length(ord_lev), nrow(excluded),
            excluded[reason == "fewer than 3 samples", .N],
            excluded[reason != "fewer than 3 samples", .N]))

# ---- ggtree display figure (circular) ----
p0 <- ggtree(genus_tree, layout = "circular",
             linewidth = 0.22, colour = "grey25")
pd <- p0$data
mx <- max(pd$x)
tip_xy <- pd[pd$isTip, ]
tip_xy$flip  <- tip_xy$angle > 90 & tip_xy$angle < 270
tip_xy$ang   <- ifelse(tip_xy$flip, tip_xy$angle + 180, tip_xy$angle)
tip_xy$lx    <- tip_xy$x + 0.01 * mx
tip_xy$hj    <- ifelse(tip_xy$flip, 1, 0)
tip_xy$order  <- df_order$Order[match(tip_xy$label, df_order$id)]
tip_xy$log2n <- df_bar$log2_samples[match(tip_xy$label, df_bar$id)]

r_ring <- c(1.34 * mx, 1.40 * mx)
r_bar0 <- 1.45 * mx
bar_scale <- 0.20 * mx / max(tip_xy$log2n)

p <- p0 +
  geom_rect(data = tip_xy, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = r_ring[1], xmax = r_ring[2],
                ymin = y - 0.5, ymax = y + 0.5, fill = order),
            colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.12) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ORD_COL, guide = "none") +
  geom_rect(data = tip_xy, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = r_bar0, xmax = r_bar0 + log2n * bar_scale,
                ymin = y - 0.40, ymax = y + 0.40),
            fill = "#1D3557", colour = NA) +
  geom_text(data = tip_xy,
            aes(x = lx, y = y, label = label, angle = ang, hjust = hj),
            size = 2.4, colour = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE)

# Tree panel without the legend / 树图主体，图例单独输出
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_1_host_genus_tree", 320, 320)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_1_host_genus_tree")

# Legend is exported separately with the shared helper / 图例单独导出
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "plot_helpers.R"))
leg_df <- data.frame(category = ord_lev, color = unname(ORD_COL),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

leg_pdf <- file.path(ch_dir(CHAPTER, "figures"),
                     "Fig_1_host_genus_tree_legend.pdf")
create_color_legend(leg_df, save_path = leg_pdf, shape = "square", layout = "row", n = 2,
                           title = "Host order", label_size = 2.8,
                           title_size = 2, ifsave = TRUE)
cat("tree legend saved:", leg_pdf, "\n")
p
```

# 15. Sample summary table (host genus x order) / 样本汇总表

```{r tab-sample-summary}
# One row per host genus, ordered by the full plant genus tree (122 genera).
# 每个宿主属一行，按完整植物属树（122 个属）的末端顺序排列。
tree_full <- read.tree(host_tree_path("plant_Genus_tree_all.nwk"))

sample_summary <- md[!is.na(Genus) & Genus != "", .(
  samples_16s = sum(dataset == "16S"),
  samples_its = sum(dataset == "ITS"),
  studies_16s = uniqueN(Cite[dataset == "16S"]),
  studies_its = uniqueN(Cite[dataset == "ITS"]),
  Source_16s  = uniqueN(source[dataset == "16S"]),
  Source_its  = uniqueN(source[dataset == "ITS"]),
  source      = paste(unique(source), collapse = "; "),
  references  = paste(unique(Cite), collapse = "; ")
), by = .(Order, Genus)]

genus_order <- data.table(index = seq_along(tree_full$tip.label),
                          Genus = tree_full$tip.label)
sample_summary <- merge(genus_order, sample_summary, by = "Genus", all.x = TRUE)
sample_summary <- sample_summary[order(index)]
sample_summary[, index := NULL]
setcolorder(sample_summary, c("Genus", "Order",
                              "samples_16s", "samples_its",
                              "studies_16s", "studies_its",
                              "Source_16s", "Source_its",
                              "source", "references"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(sample_summary$samples_16s))
write_tab(sample_summary, CHAPTER, "Tab_1_sample_summary")

cat(sprintf("sample summary: %d genera; 16S %d, ITS %d samples\n",
            nrow(sample_summary),
            sum(sample_summary$samples_16s), sum(sample_summary$samples_its)))
sample_summary
```

```{r run-log}
)
```
